kpis.title: Gross collected
kpis.definition: Income credited by paid invoices and bookings in the month, before refunds, disputes and fees (cash basis: booked when the payment is).

kpis.title: Gross collected by kind
kpis.definition: Gross collected, split by the income account's kind: membership, add-on or booking.

kpis.title: Membership revenue by tier
kpis.definition: Gross collected on membership tiers, split by tier id. A yearly payment lands whole in the month it is paid.

kpis.title: Refunds
kpis.definition: Money handed back by refunds booked in the month.

kpis.title: Disputes lost
kpis.definition: The disputes expense booked in the month: the amount a dispute withdrew, less what a won dispute gave back.

kpis.title: Dispute fees
kpis.definition: Stripe's dispute fees booked in the month.

kpis.title: Stripe fees
kpis.definition: Stripe's fees on payments the caller passed a fee for.

kpis.title: Net income
kpis.definition: Gross collected less refunds, disputes lost, dispute fees and Stripe fees (the books are cash basis, so this is also the net cash of the month).

kpis.title: Payouts
kpis.definition: Money moved to the payout clearing account in the month.

kpis.title: Payments
kpis.definition: Paid invoices and bookings booked in the month.

kpis.title: Refunds issued
kpis.definition: Refund lines booked in the month.

kpis.title: Disputes opened
kpis.definition: Disputes that withdrew money in the month.

kpis.title: Refund rate
kpis.definition: Refunds / gross collected, in the month; 0 when nothing was collected.

kpis.title: Dispute rate
kpis.definition: Disputes opened / payments, in the month; 0 when there were no payments.

kpis.title: Billed members
kpis.definition: Distinct holders granted credits by a plan in the month (a paying member or one on a zero invoice). A yearly member counts in the month it is billed only: the books hold no coverage period.

kpis.title: Billed members by tier
kpis.definition: Billed members, split by the tier of the plan that granted the credits. A member who changes tier in a month counts in each.

kpis.title: New members
kpis.definition: Holders whose first plan grant is in this month.

kpis.title: Gross collected per billed member
kpis.definition: Gross collected / billed members, in the month (cents, two decimals); 0 when there were no billed members.

kpis.title: Credits granted
kpis.definition: Credit units issued by plans and gifts in the month.

kpis.title: Credits consumed
kpis.definition: Credit units spent (finalized bookings) in the month, net of credits given back.

kpis.title: Credits expired
kpis.definition: Credit units that lapsed unused in the month (breakage).

kpis.title: Breakage rate
kpis.definition: Credits expired / credits granted, in the month; 0 when none were granted.

kpis.title: Closing balance, USD accounts
kpis.definition: Each USD account's balance at the end of the month (every posting to date). Debits are positive, so income is negative.

kpis.title: Closing balance, credit accounts
kpis.definition: Each credit account's balance at the end of the month (every posting to date), in credit units.
